desc:
VIRE is one huge mountain, and you can ski every side of it. Vire Peak stands at 4,100 m with the valley floor 2,850 m below: glacier, open faces, couloirs and forest, built from real laser-survey ground.

The helicopter sets you down at Shadow Shelf. From there, ride nine gondolas or open the map and drop in anywhere.

- 20 groomed trails (54 km), 7 couloirs and 19 drop zones
- Skis or snowboard, your pick
- 17 big jumps on three trails, plus 46 rails and boxes and 5 wall rides
- Backside Park: a 2.7 km stunt course with banked turns and a race
- Over 1,400 tricks in the Trick Book: spins to 1440, corks, rodeos, flips, grabs, grinds
- Timed race lines with medals and ghosts
- Spot records to take from other riders
- The speed wing: hold jump in the air, then dive, swoop and loop
- Clubs with their own emblems
- THE WEST: a pass-only massif up to 5,065 m

Keyboard or controller. Ride with friends for +10% XP.

Relief: IGN LiDAR HD, Copernicus DEM (ESA).
